description: Gnat cloud — 50k agents, Brownian jitter + weak cohesion = hover swarm. Mating swarm model: cloud shape is stable but individual paths are random.
reference: Okubo 1986; Okubo & Chiang 1974 — Gnat swarm dynamics
notes: Individual gnats perform 3D random walks (Brownian motion with persistence). The cloud as a whole is held by a quadratic well anchored to a landmark (e.g. post, thermal). Mating males exhibit faster mean-reversion to the anchor than females.
